title: Etale local finite restriction of a closed affine relation
statement: Let $T,U,R$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Let $U\to T$ be locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], and let $s,t:R\to U$ be etale morphisms over $T$ [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Suppose $j=(s,t):R\to U\times_TU$ is a closed immersion [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion] identifying $R(H)$ with an equivalence relation on $U(H)$ for every $T$-scheme $H$. For every $u\in U$, with image $p\in T$, there exist an affine scheme $T'$, an etale map $T'\to T$, a point $p'\in T'$ over $p$ inducing an isomorphism of residue fields [def-weil-residue-field], and decompositions into open and closed subschemes $U\times_TT'=U'\amalg W$, $R\times_TT'=R'\amalg W'$, with a point $u'\in U'$ over both $u$ and $p'$, such that $U'$ and $R'$ are finite over $T'$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and $R'=U'\times_{U\times_TT',s}(R\times_TT')\times_{t,U\times_TT'}U'$ as a restricted relation. The restricted projections $s',t':R'\to U'$ are etale and form an equivalence relation. Open and closed subschemes have their induced scheme structures [def-weil-open-immersion].

source.place: Tag 03X5 (lemma-quasi-finite-over-base-j-proper), specialized to an affine etale equivalence relation with closed relation map; conclusions (a), (d), (g), (h), with an affine shrinking of the etale neighbourhood.
